title: Sunday · Gully's at Christmas
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Gully's shack strung with lights, the dock, the corkboard through the window with twenty years on it, the flyers' wall with a wreath, the pup at the door. The town's warm room.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the shack and dock at dusk strung with colored lights doubled in the water, a wreath on the flyers' wall, smoke from the stovepipe.

image.prompt: a shingle bait shack and dock at dusk strung with colored lights doubled in the water, a wreath on a wall of pinned flyers and smoke from a stovepipe, no words

panels.name: Lights

panels.composition: Tier 2: through the window, the corkboard above the register: twenty years of things, lit warm.

image.prompt: a crowded corkboard above a shop register seen through a window lit warm from inside, no words

panels.name: Board

panels.composition: Tier 3: the door, open a crack, the pup in the gap, light on the planks. Held.

image.prompt: a shack door open a crack with a small three-legged dog in the gap and warm light spilling onto dock planks at dusk, no words

panels.name: Door

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The warm room. The pup in the gap.
